title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5.1, section 3 (Liumchen East Forest Service Road etc.)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5.1 [en. B.C. Reg. 135/2017, App. 1, s. 2.] No Shooting Areas — Specified Crown Land (Section 7.1)
Liumchen East Forest Service Road etc.
3 Those portions of M.U. 2-3 being all Crown land within 400 m of the midline of the following roads: (a)Liumchen East Forest Service Road; (b)Little Tamihi Forest Service Road; (c)Liumchen West Forest Service Road; (d)Little Tamihi 1000 Forest Service Road. [am. B.C. Reg. 115/2018, App. 1, s. 2.]
